what: Testing strategy treats partition guard as sufficient for test-classify-bump fix but extract_pytest only attributes files[0]
scenario_or_breakage: Makefile:353-354 still runs python/test_release.py in full on shard 19; guard binds test-classify-bump to python/test_version_bump.py only so ENFORCED can pass while test_release.py keeps an extra invisible full-file CI run defeating the Bucket 1 win
suggested_fix: Add an explicit acceptance step: grep or inspect test-classify-bump recipe confirms python/test_release.py is absent (or split into a version_bump-only target); do not rely on scripts/lint-harness-pytest-partition.py alone to catch a leftover second file
